1549-commentary-on-the-epistle-to-the-ga.creator: Martin Luther
1549-commentary-on-the-epistle-to-the-ga.description: A book by Martin Luther. three octavo pages in the Weidman Edition of his works. We were resolved not to present this entire mass of exegesis. It would have run to more than fifteen hundred pages, ordinary octavo (like this), since it is impossible to use the compressed structure of sentences which is characteristic of Latin, and particularly of Luther’s Latin.

37019-the-girls-of-central-high-or-rival.description: A book by Gertrude W. Morrison. The side window of James Belding’s jewelry store was open behind the grillwork of strong steel bars. Laura had just finished dusting the inside of the last show case in the row on that side of the wide shop, and had replaced the trays. This was Laura Belding’s usual Saturday morning task; her father would not trust Chet to do it, although the lad often waited on customers.

77020-ten-recreational-parties.title: Ten Recreational Parties
77020-ten-recreational-parties.creator: Unknown
77020-ten-recreational-parties.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. At a given signal from the director, each person at the table tries to guess the number of peanuts in the bowl. After all the players have had their chance, the peanuts are counted. The person who came nearest to the correct number receives four peanuts as a reward, which he keeps for the final counting.

arxiv-2103-12163.title: The numerical solutions of linear semi-discrete evolution problems on the half-line using the Unified Transform Method
arxiv-2103-12163.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . We discuss a semi-discrete analogue of the Unified Transform Method, introduced by A. Fokas, to solve initial-boundary-value problems for linear evolution partial differential equations of constant coefficients. The semi-discrete method is applied to various spacial discretizations of several first and second-order linear equations on the half-line x ≥ 0 x\geq 0 , producing the exact solution for the semi-discrete problem, given appropriate initial and boundary data.

arxiv-2312-07055.title: Communication Cost Reduction for Subgraph Counting under Local Differential Privacy via Hash Functions
arxiv-2312-07055.creator: Quentin Hillebrand, Vorapong Suppakitpaisarn, Tetsuo Shibuya
arxiv-2312-07055.description: Abstract We suggest the use of hash functions to cut down the communication costs when counting subgraphs under edge local differential privacy. While various algorithms exist for computing graph statistics, including the count of subgraphs, under the edge local differential privacy, many suffer with high communication costs, making them less efficient for large graphs.

arxiv-2412-04358.title: Approximate Top- 𝒌 \bm{k} for Increased Parallelism
arxiv-2412-04358.creator: Oscar Key Luka Ribar Alberto Cattaneo Luke Hudlass-Galley Douglas Orr
arxiv-2412-04358.description: Abstract We present an evaluation of bucketed approximate top- k k algorithms. Computing top- k k exactly suffers from limited parallelism, because the k k largest values must be aggregated along the vector, thus is not well suited to computation on highly-parallel machine learning accelerators.

arxiv-2511-05162.title: Mind the Gap… or Not? How Translation Errors and Evaluation Details Skew Multilingual Results
arxiv-2511-05162.creator: Jan-Thorsten Peter David Vilar Tobias Domhan
arxiv-2511-05162.description: Abstract Most current large language models (LLMs) support a wide variety of languages in addition to English, including high-resource languages (e.g. German, Chinese, French), as well as low-resource ones (e.g. Swahili, Telugu). In addition they have also shown impressive capabilities in different domains, like coding, science and math.

arxiv-2601-12272.title: AgenticPruner: MAC-Constrained Neural Network Compression via LLM-Driven Strategy Search
arxiv-2601-12272.creator: Shahrzad Esmat, Mahdi Banisharif, Ali Jannesari
arxiv-2601-12272.description: Abstract Neural network pruning remains essential for deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained devices, yet existing approaches primarily target parameter reduction without directly controlling computational cost. This yields unpredictable inference latency in deployment scenarios where strict Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) operation budgets must be met. We propose AgenticPruner, a framework utilizing large language models to achieve MAC-constrained optimization through iterative strategy learning.

pmc-10628258.creator: Siyi Huang, Xianfeng Wang, Xinchong Chen, Xiaoyu Liu, Qiuqing Xu, Lijun Zhang, Guangtao Huang, Jun Wu
pmc-10628258.description: CRISPR based technologies have been used for fast and sensitive detection of pathogens. To test the possibility of CRISPR based detection strategy in Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections, a combined method of recombinase polymerase amplification followed by Cas12a-mediated detection via fluorescence reader or lateral flow biosensor (named Cas12a-RCFL) has been established in this study.

pmc-10673504.title: Analytical Methods Based on the Mass Balance Approach for Purity Evaluation of Tetracycline Hydrochloride
pmc-10673504.creator: Sunyoung Lee, Song-Yee Baek, Ha-Jeong Kwon, Ki Hwan Choi, Jeesoo Han, Michele De Luca, Stefan Platikanov
pmc-10673504.description: Analytical methods based on the mass balance approach were developed for the purity evaluation of tetracycline hydrochloride, a representative salt compound used in pure veterinary drug analysis. The purity assignment method was used to quantify individual classes of impurities via independent analytical techniques.

pmc-11479310.title: SSIM-Based Autoencoder Modeling to Defeat Adversarial Patch Attacks
pmc-11479310.creator: Seungyeol Lee, Seongwoo Hong, Gwangyeol Kim, Jaecheol Ha, Tiago Cruz, Paulo Alexandre Ferreira Simões, Jesús Ureña
pmc-11479310.description: Object detection systems are used in various fields such as autonomous vehicles and facial recognition. In particular, object detection using deep learning networks enables real-time processing in low-performance edge devices and can maintain high detection rates. However, edge devices that operate far from administrators are vulnerable to various physical attacks by malicious adversaries.

pmc-11515805.title: Drug-gene interactions in older patients with coronary artery disease
pmc-11515805.creator: Shizhao Zhang, Chao Lv, Lisha Dong, Yangxun Wu, Tong Yin
pmc-11515805.description: BackgroundOlder patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) are particularly vulnerable to the efficacy and adverse drug reactions, and may therefore particularly benefit from personalized medication. Drug–gene interactions (DGIs) occur when an individual’s genotype affects the pharmacokinetics and/or pharmacodynamics of a victim drug.

pmc-11646660.title: A review on toxic epidermal necrolysis‐like superficial wound lesions: Issue and challenge on 10 clinical entities
pmc-11646660.creator: Bahareh Abtahi‐Naeini, Mahsa Pourmahdi‐Boroujeni, Fereshte Rastegarnasab, Ali Emamjomeh
pmc-11646660.description: Toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN) is a severe skin reaction caused by extensive epidermal and mucosal necrosis. This clinical phenomenon is known as an acute syndrome of apoptotic pan‐epidermolysis (ASAP). The ASAP phenomenon is observed in conditions that mimic TEN, highlighting the challenge in distinguishing these conditions.

pmc-12613618.title: Plant identity and environmental filtering are the key drivers of bacterial community structure in four desert plant species from the Sahara Desert in Morocco
pmc-12613618.creator: Hafsa Debbagh-Nour, Said Khourchi, Ayoub El Mouttaqi, Rachid Elfermi, Anass Bourazza, Oscar Pascal Malou, Marc Ducousso, Hassan Boukcim, Mohamed Hijri, Abdelaziz Hirich
pmc-12613618.description: BackgroundPlant microbiome is a very wide research area playing a major role in agriculture and plant health. This study investigates the interactions between root-associated bacterial communities and soil physico-chemical characteristics of four Moroccan desert plant species: Lavandula coronopifolia Poir. (n = 20), Lycium intricatum Boiss. (n = 20), Nitraria retusa Asch. (n = 20) and Searsia tripartita (Ucria) Moffett.

pmc-12654387.title: Spinning and Tactile Hand/Wear Comfort Characteristics of PET/Co-PET Hollow Fabrics Made of Inorganic Particles Embedded Sheath/3-Core Bicomponent Yarns
pmc-12654387.creator: Jiman Kang, Hyunah Kim
pmc-12654387.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This paper reports the spinning and wear comfort properties of polyethylene terephthalate (PET)/copolymer-PET (Co-PET) hollow yarns and their fabrics, as well as the effect of the wt.% of inorganic particles embedded in the core of the bicomponent yarns. The results are discussed in terms of the types and amounts of inorganic particles (titanium dioxide (TiO2) and calcium carbonate (CaCO3)) embedded in the sheath of the bi-component yarns (Kolon semi-dull (KSD), Kolon full-dull (KFD), and Kolon calcium carbonate (KCC) PET/Co-PET yarns).

pmc-12817533.title: Clinical and genetic analysis of a family with transthyretin amyloid polyneuropathy caused by a TTR Lys55Asn mutation
pmc-12817533.creator: Nannan Qian, Taohua Wei, Yufei Qian, Wenming Yang, Hui Han, Huaizhen Chen, Jun Li
pmc-12817533.description: Backgroundtransthyretin-mediated familial amyloid polyneuropathy (ATTR-PN), caused by TTR gene mutations, leads to systemic amyloid deposition and multisystem dysfunction. The c.165G > C (p.Lys55Asn) mutation is a rare variant with limited clinical data. This study investigates a family with this mutation, focusing on genotype-phenotype correlations and clinical challenges.

pmc-13046343.title: Maintenance of oral hygiene with beetroot rinse in gingivitis patients with oral lichen planus: A pilot randomized controlled trial
pmc-13046343.creator: Snehlata Kaushik, Rameshwari Singhal, Samiksha Dubey, Vikram Khanna, Abbas Ali Mahdi, Prashant Gupta, Pavitra Rastogi
pmc-13046343.description: Background:Oral lichen planus (OLP) is a chronic inflammatory mucocutaneous disorder frequently associated with painful gingival involvement, which can compromise effective plaque control. Chlorhexidine (CHX) is the gold standard chemical plaque control agent but may be poorly tolerated in OLP patients due to mucosal irritation. Natural alternatives such as beetroot juice, rich in bioactive compounds, may offer supportive benefits.

pmc-13355009.title: Recurrent epithelioid trophoblastic tumor with complete response after surgery, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy: A case report and literature review
pmc-13355009.creator: Lingting Meng, Bin Yang, Jiaqi Ma, Juan Zhang, Lei Lei, Ye Hong, Xiaojun Hu
pmc-13355009.description: Background:Epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) is the rarest form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasm, accounting for 1.39–2% of gestational trophoblastic diseases. Its clinical behavior and pathogenesis remain poorly understood, and no standardized treatment guidelines currently exist, with surgery considered the most important therapeutic option. Emerging modalities, including immune checkpoint inhibitors, are under investigation.

uslaw-usc-t33-s927.title: 33 U.S.C. § 927 — Powers of deputy commissioners or Board
uslaw-usc-t33-s927.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s927.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 18 (Longshore And Harbor Workers’ Compensation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The deputy commissioner or Board shall have power to preserve and enforce order during any such proceedings; to issue subpoenas for, to administer oaths to, and to compel the attendance and testimony of witnesses, or the production of books, papers.
